connections.why: Each approach offers a contrasting set of assumptions about behaviour
Cognitive psychology arose partly as a reaction to behaviourism's black box
The biological approach supplies explanations for behaviours like schizophrenia
Conditioning principles underpin behavioural methods of modification
Cognitive approaches inform therapies that change thinking patterns
Method principles are put into practice in the personal investigations
The chosen design determines which statistical analysis is appropriate
Conducting investigations requires applying ethics and assessing validity
Studying real-world behaviours relies on evaluating the underlying research
Biological determinism feeds the free-will versus determinism debate
Socially sensitive and animal research raise the ethical controversies
Psychodynamic theory is central to debates about scientific status and bias
Explaining a behaviour is the basis for designing ways to modify it
